about.p1: I’m Jawad, a full-stack developer based in Lebanon. I connect interfaces, APIs, data, and background processes into products that make complicated workflows easier to use.
about.p2: My work spans ISP operations, clinic administration, community platforms, deployment utilities, and the Rust+ ecosystem. I build my own products and contribute to collaborative open-source applications.
